, although reputation is an important asset in the banking sector, the degree of transparency of the firm is not as important as the degree of satisfaction that stakeholders perceive from the firm’s behaviour.

the reputation of Spanish financial intermediaries is a valuable intangible asset, which is positively correlated with the financial performance of the firm and with the degree of transparency with which the company develops its relations with its stakeholders.
